## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue/feature (if applicable).

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🎨 Code style / formatting / refactoring
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have verified formatting with `pnpm format`.
- [ ] I have verified quality with `pnpm validate` (`lint`, `check`, `test`).
- [ ] The production build succeeds with `pnpm build`.
